usageNotes: This endpoint is strictly internal to the Proxmox live-migration subsystem — it upgrades an HTTP connection to a WebSocket tunnel used to relay data between source and destination nodes during LXC container migration. It should not be called directly by external tooling; the correct entry point is the mtunnel API call, which issues the socket path and ticket required here. The ticket is short-lived and scoped to the specific unix socket, so both values must be obtained immediately before use.

examples.summary: WebSocket upgrade for an in-progress LXC migration (as initiated by the migration subsystem)

tips: Never call this endpoint manually — it is invoked automatically by pve-manager during container live migration.
The ticket is obtained from the initial mtunnel call or via the 'ticket' tunnel command; it expires quickly.
Permissions are validated through the ticket itself, not through the standard PVE privilege tree, which is why 'user: all' is shown in the spec.
A failed or stale ticket will result in an authentication error; restart the migration rather than retrying with the same ticket.
